name: banger
description: Operate product, lifecycle, and marketing email with Banger.

interface.longDescription: Send and receive company email, create mailboxes, operate transactional email, build campaigns and sequences, manage audiences, monitor delivery, and run governed automations with Banger.
defaultPrompt: Start with a plan for my business. Ask which product or company and domain this is for, gather the relevant context you can access, save a reviewable proposal in Banger, and do not execute anything until I approve it.
Create the mailboxes and lifecycle sequences my business needs.
Review deliverability, pending approvals, and what Banger should do next.
